covers: The OKI MSM5205 ADPCM sound chip as a chip

left_out.why: Same handlers, but its S1 and S2 selectors give the divisors 160, 80, 40 and 20, the capture follows VCK by 2 clocks instead of 6, and it has no slave mode, so the msm5205 handler entries do not describe it; its layout was read in msm5205.cpp and msm5205.h and is not mapped as an entry here.

entries.name: OKI MSM5205 ADPCM
entries.description: OKI MSM5205 ADPCM sample decoder with no registers: a program feeds it one nibble per sample through handlers and pins.
entries.behaviour: Driven only by handler calls and pins. A driver writes a nibble with data_w when VCK asks for it and picks the sample rate with the S1 and S2 selectors; the output is one channel at the chip clock. The MSM6585 class shares these handlers but not the divisors.
